t: 乔治·华盛顿在纽约市发表首次国情咨文演讲。
te: George Washington delivers the first State of the Union address in New York City.
dz: 乔治·华盛顿在纽约市发表首次国情咨文演讲。
de: George Washington delivers the first State of the Union address in New York City.

t: 法国被划分为83个省,跨越了前几省,试图以贵族对地的所有权为基础,将地区忠诚驱离.
te: France is divided into 83 départements, cutting across the former provinces in an attempt to dislodge regional loyaltie…
dz: 法国被划分为83个省,跨越了前几省,试图以贵族对地的所有权为基础,将地区忠诚驱离.
de: France is divided into 83 départements, cutting across the former provinces in an attempt to dislodge regional loyalties based on ownership of land by the nobility.

t: 鲁索-土耳其战争(1787–1792):希腊私家兰博斯·卡特索尼斯在安德罗斯战役中损失了三艘船.
te: Russo-Turkish war (1787–1792): Greek privateer Lambros Katsonis loses three of his ships in the Battle of Andros.
dz: 鲁索-土耳其战争(1787–1792):希腊私家兰博斯·卡特索尼斯在安德罗斯战役中损失了三艘船.
de: Russo-Turkish war (1787–1792): Greek privateer Lambros Katsonis loses three of his ships in the Battle of Andros.

t: 罗德岛州成为北美最初十三个殖民地中最后一个批准宪法并成为美国之一的殖民地。
te: Rhode Island becomes the last of North America's original Thirteen Colonies to ratify the Constitution and become one o…
dz: 罗德岛州成为北美最初十三个殖民地中最后一个批准宪法并成为美国之一的殖民地。
de: Rhode Island becomes the last of North America's original Thirteen Colonies to ratify the Constitution and become one of the United States.

t: 美国颁布了第一部版权法规"1790年版权法".

dz: 美国颁布了第一部版权法规"1790年版权法".
de: The United States enacts its first copyright statute, the Copyright Act of 1790.

t: 曼努埃尔·昆佩尔探索了胡安·德富卡海峡.

dz: 曼努埃尔·昆佩尔探索了胡安·德富卡海峡.

dz: 瑞典海军夺取了俄罗斯波罗的海舰队的三分之一.

dz: 教士会的民事宪法由法国全国制宪会议通过.

t: 为了庆祝法国人民的团结和民族和解,法国妇女联合会举行了成立典礼.
te: Inaugural Fête de la Fédération is held to celebrate the unity of the French people and the national reconciliation.
dz: 为了庆祝法国人民的团结和民族和解,法国妇女联合会举行了成立典礼.
de: Inaugural Fête de la Fédération is held to celebrate the unity of the French people and the national reconciliation.

t: 《居住法》签署后，哥伦比亚特区被确立为美国的首都。
te: The District of Columbia is established as the capital of the United States after signature of the Residence Act.
dz: 《居住法》签署后，哥伦比亚特区被确立为美国的首都。
de: The District of Columbia is established as the capital of the United States after signature of the Residence Act.

t: 第一项美国专利授予发明者塞缪尔·霍普金斯 (Samuel Hopkins)，用于钾肥工艺。

dz: 第一项美国专利授予发明者塞缪尔·霍普金斯 (Samuel Hopkins)，用于钾肥工艺。

dz: 美国进行了第一次人口普查.
de: The first United States Census is conducted.

te: A newly passed tariff act creates the Revenue Cutter Service (the forerunner of the United States Coast Guard).
dz: 新通过的《关税法》设立了税收切割处(美国海岸警卫队的前身).

dz: 埃德蒙·伯克(Edmund Burke)出版"关于法国革命的反思",其中他预测法国大革命会以灾难结束.
